upgradeDowngrade.question: What happens if I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
upgradeDowngrade.answer: If you upgrade, you'll be charged a prorated amount for the remaining time in your billing cycle. If you downgrade, the changes will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

setupFee.question: Is there a setup fee?
setupFee.answer: No, there are no setup fees. You can start using {appName} immediately after signing up.

exceedLimits.question: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
exceedLimits.answer: If you exceed your plan limits, you'll receive an alert and can either upgrade to a higher plan or adjust your usage to stay within your current plan.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.description: Learn how we use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our platform.

whatAreCookies.title: What are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us improve your experience by remembering preferences.

typesOfCookies.title: Types of Cookies
typesOfCookies.content: We use both session and persistent cookies to track user activity and enhance site functionality.

managingCookies.title: Managing Cookies
managingCookies.content: You can control cookie settings in your browser. However, disabling cookies may impact your experience on our site.

cookiesWeUse.title: Cookies We Use
cookiesWeUse.content: We use cookies for functionality (e.g., sessions), performance (e.g., analytics), and advertising (e.g., targeted ads).

thirdPartyCookies.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdPartyCookies.content: We may allow third-party services (such as Google Analytics) to place cookies on your device for specific purposes.

howToManage.title: How to Manage Cookies
howToManage.content: You can adjust cookie settings in your browser. For more detailed instructions, refer to your browser's help guide.

changes.title: Changes to Our Cookie Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your data. Please read carefully to understand our practices.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you interact with our platform.

informationCollection.title: Information Collection
informationCollection.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you sign up or interact with our services.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: We use your data to provide, personalize, and improve your experience on our platform, including marketing and support.

dataProtection.title: How We Protect Your Data
dataProtection.content: We implement various security measures, including encryption and secure storage, to protect your personal information.

thirdPartySharing.title: Third-Party Sharing
thirdPartySharing.content: We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers for essential operations like payment processing or analytics.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time. You can also opt-out of marketing communications.

cookiesTracking.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookiesTracking.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to personalize your experience and analyze usage patterns on our site.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted here, and continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance.
